checklist.can: See when your calendar is busy and add the bookings your teammates handle.
checklist.label: Calendar
checklist.cannot: Your teammates are not allowed to read what your events are about, change or delete events, or delete calendars.

checklist.can: Send email from your own address for the jobs your teammates handle.
checklist.label: Email from your address
checklist.cannot: Your teammates are not allowed to read, delete or forward your inbox.

checklist.can: Add rows to one sheet that Pip makes for you in your Google Drive.
checklist.label: A spreadsheet
checklist.cannot: Your teammates are not allowed to open your other files.

checklist.can: Chat with visitors on your website, and say it is an AI in the first message.
checklist.label: Website chat
checklist.cannot: It never asks for card numbers, IDs or passwords.

checklist.can: See open times and book, move or cancel appointments inside the rules you set.
checklist.label: Booking software
checklist.cannot: Your teammates are not allowed to change prices, services or staff.

checklist.can: Reply to reviews and post updates.
checklist.label: Google Business Profile
checklist.cannot: Your teammates never remove reviews or ask only happy customers.
checklist.lead_time: Waiting on Google's approval of Pip

checklist.can: Count people at tables and in line.
checklist.label: Camera box
checklist.cannot: No faces, no identities and no stored video. A sign at the entrance is required.
checklist.lead_time: 1 to 2 weeks for the box to arrive
